description: Java class defining the 'DeleteConnection' command in the Eclipse Ditto project, used for deleting a connectivity connection identified by 'ConnectionId'. Contains methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and standard object overrides.

classes.name: DeleteConnection
classes.description: Immutable command class for deleting a Connection in the Ditto framework, providing creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and overrides.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DeleteConnection instance with given ConnectionId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a DeleteConnection from a JSON string or object with parsing logic.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionId associated with this delete command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of DeleteConnection with the provided headers.
